D: A charming Englishman keeps running into the same American woman at a run of weddings.
P: Serve the snacks when the guests pour into the first wedding reception.
S: Charles racing in late to the first wedding

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, beside asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto and grilled. Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and dill. Blanch a bunch of asparagus for a minute, wrap each spear in prosciutto and grill until crisp. Arrange both on trays for the first of several weddings.
the old pub where Charles and Carrie stay the night

Aged cheddar, thick-cut ham, sharp pickled onions, a jammy egg with mustard salt and tomato chutney, with crusty bread, cold butter and apple. Boil 4 eggs for 7 minutes, cool in iced water, peel, halve and sprinkle with salt mixed with a pinch of mustard powder. Cut 250g aged cheddar into thick wedges and fold 200g thick-cut ham onto a big board. Add 8 pickled onions, a bowl of tomato chutney, 1 sliced green apple tossed in lemon, a handful of watercress and the eggs. Slice a crusty loaf thickly and serve with a block of cold butter.

Oatcakes spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon. Spread oatcakes with cream cheese. Top with folds of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Squeeze over a little lemon and lay them out on a slate for a castle wedding in the Highlands.
M: Highland braised lamb, neeps and tatties

Lamb shoulder braised 3 hours with onion, carrots and barley, with mashed neeps and tatties. Season 1.5kg lamb shoulder and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 chopped onions, 3 carrots in chunks, 75g pearl barley, rosemary and 750ml chicken stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until it pulls apart. Boil 800g peeled potatoes and 600g swede separately until soft. Mash the potatoes with 50g butter and a splash of milk and the swede with 30g butter and pepper. Serve the lamb and barley over both with the juices.
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy made from the pan juices.
W: Two lemon butter sponges filled with lemon curd and whipped cream, iced white and finished with fresh flowers like a country wedding. Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and lemon zest, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, ice white and decorate with fresh flowers.
K: Gareth's loud waistcoats and louder toasts

Elderflower cordial and lemon over cucumber ribbons, topped with cold sparkling wine. Peel 1 Lebanese cucumber into long ribbons and curl one into each of 4 flutes or wine glasses. Add 20ml elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each. Top slowly with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle. For drivers, use sparkling water and a little extra cordial.
